items.title: These 3 Monthly ETFs Pay High Yields. Here’s the Catch Behind Each Check
items.summary: Monthly ETF checks sound like a retirement paycheck replacement, but each of these three high-yield funds hides a different flaw that the yield number alone never shows you.

items.title: 16 Big Funds Bought Carvana. It’s 23% Below Its High. Bargain or Trap?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSixteen big funds reported more Carvana shares on June 30 than on March 31, but May’s 5-for-1 split explains most of that, and only 10 added meaningfully. Carvana sold a record 217,385 cars in the third quarter, up 39%, but adjusted EBITDA per car fell from a year earlier for a fourth straight quarter.

items.title: Carvana Sold a Record 217,385 Cars. Its Director Just Sold $2.25 Million of Stock
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCarvana has gained 24% since Oct. 12 after third-quarter retail units rose 39% to a record 217,385 and revenue jumped 42% to $8.

items.title: Carvana Soared 27% in the Week Ending Nov. 2 After Its First 200,000-Car Quarter: “The Moat Is Widening”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCarvana (CVNA) stock surged 27% from October 26 through November 2 after reporting record quarterly retail sales of 217,385 vehicles, up 39% year over year. CarMax (KMX) reported 13% comparable-store used vehicle sales growth, although gross profit per retail vehicle declined $111.

items.title: Is Carvana (CVNA) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?

items.title: Needham names Carvana top pick, flags bullish catalysts for EV stocks
